emulator.name: PCSX2
emulator.profile: private copy of the M12 PCSX2 profile (itself a copy of the M11 profile; patches, cheats and widescreen hacks disabled); save-state slot 1 SHA-256 1d8798faaeaf042caddf5f933c083dc7654f420ea26223db8bec41214926808d

operation.input: Save-state slot 1 loads the player at (48.5, 265.0) facing +1.5708 rad. Keyboard D (stick X) was held until the heading reached -0.797 (the M12 heading; running, no stop armed below Z 271), then W (stick Y +1) was held. After 8 completed frames D was also held (stick (0.704, 0.710)); after 12 both were released for 10+ frames so the walk brakes to zero and stationary updates continue. Pad input reaches the game about two frames after a key change.
operation.feature: static +Z side wall of the starting corridor near Z 276.6; approach about 45 degrees to the wall, sliding toward -X; floor rising +X (normal about (-0.0033, 1, 0))
operation.observation_run: obs3: one continuous serialized run with the M13 breakpoints (gate Z > 271.0, plus the coordinator stops 0012f850/0012f8a8 in every frame)

breakpoints: Execute breakpoints conditioned on player Z > 271.0 ([3f9308,4] > 0x43878000): stage stops 0012f850, 0012f8a8, 00158560, 0015ebc0, 0015fc10, 0015e420, 0015e494, 0015fca8, 00160404, 001589f0, 0012c790, 0012f8d4; push branches 0015ef80/0015f2b0/0015f654/0015fa5c; sentinels for special surfaces (0015ed3c/0015f13c/0015f4bc/0015f8c4) and every unsupported 0015e420 branch (0015e888 no floor, 0015e4ac type 7, 0015e554 type 6, 0015e594 special, 0015e6cc type 5, 0015e7c8 spawn check, 0015e858 non-0x100 hit).
native_pc_binding: Screenshot of the PCSX2 debugger at each pause; the highlighted row and both neighbours are OCR-read; a PC is accepted only when at least two of {row, previous+4, next-4} agree. Registers: tesseract majority over 15-30 preprocessing variants (ocr-vote), or read by eye when OCR was unresolved or disagreed with the calculated value (visual; f00 and f12 rows agree). Twelve stops whose screenshots did not yield an OCR reading were bound deterministically from the fixed per-frame breakpoint order (constraint-entry 0015ebc0 and grounded-entry 0015fc10 fire every frame and are the only armed stops able to occupy those positions); recorded as sequence-inferred with neighbour evidence and player X/Z corroboration from the captured samples. The coordinator-counter stop (0012f8a8) reads the counter after the increment and belongs to the same frame; captures filed accordingly (validated per capture sample).

sequence_evidence.rule: only armed stop between coordinator-entry (0012f850, obs3-198) and dispatch-entry (00158560, obs3-200) is the coordinator-counter stop (0012f8a8); the capture’s own debugger OCR text reads 0012f8a8

fixed per-frame breakpoint order: constraint-entry (0015ebc0) and grounded-entry (0015fc10) are armed and fire every frame; no other armed stop can occupy this position between dispatch-entry and the head push / floor-entry
sequence_evidence.corroboration: player X/Z in captured samples: walk moved player (XZ changed); matches the stage semantics at these stops

limitations: Frames 10180-10185: constraint-entry/grounded-entry PCs are sequence-inferred (screenshots archived, no OCR reading); register panels were not OCR-read for these frames (not consumed by the verifier).
Native stops bracket stages; callee instructions are established by authenticated instructions and captured state, not per-instruction stops.
Register values are OCR or visual readings of debugger panels; RAM/scratchpad comparisons are the primary evidence.
The turn phase runs with the coordinator stops armed (Z below 271.0 does not satisfy the gate, so no stop fires).
